args.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this one COMPLETE rear-view blue-white mounted knight pixel-art sprite, transparent background. Keep the same knight, helmet/plume, armor, shield on image left, vertical wooden lance on right, hands, saddlecloth, horse rump, black tail, limited colors, dark crisp pixel outlines. Same rear-view camera, same proportions. Rider head, horse body, saddle and all upper-body pixels should remain in the same positions. Change ONLY the horse lower-leg POSE: this is an AIRBORNE gallop tuck while moving AWAY from the viewer. All FOUR legs are bent BACKWARD and UP tightly underneath/behind the rump, with hooves much HIGHER above the ground. The legs are strongly foreshortened and mostly HIDDEN behind the rump and tail. Show only two small folded knee/hoof shapes near the lower side edges of the rump, and tiny slivers of the farther pair if necessary. No long dangling white lower legs, no V-shaped long crossed shins, no straight leg reaching below the tail tip, no hoof touching the ground. The hooves should be at or ABOVE the lower third of the black tail; black tail tip remains the lowest point of the horse silhouette. Four anatomically complete folded legs must still be present but much less visible due to overlap, rather than amputated. Rump stays at the same height: increased ground clearance comes from bending and tucking the legs, NOT lifting/resizing/moving the entire horse or rider. One complete sprite, generous transparent margin, no text, no ground shadow, no effects.
